decisions.reason: GA4 is now the mandatory Google Analytics standard, so demand from shop clients meets aspirations and the plugin fits the firm's core analytics offering.
Google shut down Universal Analytics in 2023, so the plugin's results inevitably fall short of aspirations and its resources are better shifted to the GA4 plugin.
The retail system interface supports the firm's established interface-development strength and recurring integration demand, giving no shortfall that would prompt dropping it.
Relaunch SEO support is a low-cost, high-relevance service tied to the firm's core relaunch projects, and its dedicated page signals satisfactory performance.
